title: Mrs. Michal Tawil: What Will they Say Destruction in the Making (Class # 26)

chapters.title: Introduction to Midrashim on the Hurban and Avoda
chapters.about: Midrashim on the destruction, connecting past stories to personal avoda.

chapters.title: The Story of Anat and Her Roommate
chapters.about: A story of a roommate's illness, passing away, and looking beyond the outer shell.

chapters.title: Relinquishing Din and Cultivating Compassion
chapters.about: Moving away from harsh self-judgment and comparing it to the goal of Midian.

chapters.title: Lessons from Kansa and Bar Kansa
chapters.about: Examining the story of the destruction of Jerusalem and internal self-destruction.

chapters.title: Rabban Yochanan ben Zakai and Saving Torah
chapters.about: The meeting with Abba Sikra, escaping Jerusalem, and asking Vespasian for Yavneh.

chapters.title: Putting the Mouth Before the Eye in Echa
chapters.about: Exploring Echa, the Spies, and the danger of speaking before looking with a good eye.

summary: Mrs. Tawil discusses lessons from the destruction of the Bet HaMikdash and personal stories of self-reflection, focusing on moving past the outer shell of past mistakes and judgment to find core values and inner ratson. She connects the concept of putting the mouth before the eye to negative judgment and self-destruction, encouraging a compassionate, forward-looking approach instead of worrying about what others will say.
questions: Why do we beat ourselves up over past mistakes instead of focusing on what we can do now?
What can we learn from the story of Kansa and Bar Kansa regarding how we destroy ourselves?
What does it mean to put the mouth before the eye in Echa and in our daily lives?
How does worrying about what other people will say cause us to lose our authentic selves?
